name: X-Ray
description: Amazon-style X-Ray for movies and shows: who is in the current scene (faces, plus voices for cartoons and costumed characters) and the song that is playing.
overview: Who is on screen, and what is playing.

versions.changelog:
No extra plugin needed: the player overlay now works out of the box.
- File Transformation's middleware is bundled; if you already have File Transformation installed, X-Ray uses it instead.
- Licence changes from MIT to GPL-3.0 (includes code from File Transformation by IAmParadox27).
